text: This can's bottom is dented. I'll pop it flat.

speaker: fitz
text:
Wait. That dome is on purpose.
Soda holds carbon dioxide under pressure, pushing out on every part of the can.

speaker: gauge
text: So a flat bottom would bulge?

speaker: fitz
text: It can stretch and bulge out. A dome curving inward holds that push better, so the metal can stay thin.

speaker: gauge
text: And the ring it stands on?

speaker: fitz
text: It's narrower, so it nests into the lid of the can below. That helps stacks sit steady.

speaker: gauge
text: Ooh, what else is built weird? Subscribe and let's find out.
